answer: In a Proof of Agent economy, peers form trust graphs verified by multi-agent auditing. To resist Sybil clusters, a peer summit inspects topological cut verifications across clusters; if an audited boundary reveals artificial subgraphs, collateral locked in each identity's vault is destroyed via stake slashing. Coordinated attacks face superlinear attacker cost as forging realistic cross-graph paths scales rapidly, like tracking an elusive comet across independent audit rings.
